title: Part 4 天氣預報與導覽
summary: 天氣預報和參觀導覽：時間順序最重要。

steps.title: 重點觀念
body: 天氣預報會說「什麼時候、什麼天氣」，還常建議聽眾做什麼（帶傘、穿外套）。
導覽會先自我介紹（My name is…, I'll be your guide），再依順序說行程：First…, After that…, The tour will end…，最後說注意事項。

steps.title: 解題技巧
steps.tip: 順序題：聽 First → After that → Finally，用手指頭記下順序。

items.en: Heavy rain is expected in the afternoon.

steps.title: 模擬練習
steps.intro: 先看題目，再按 ▶ 聽。每段有 3 題。

questions.prompt: 明天下午的天氣會如何？
questions.explanation:
heavy rain is expected in the afternoon. 早上才是晴天。
逐字稿：Good evening. Here is the weather report. Tomorrow will be sunny in the morning, but heavy rain is expected in the afternoon. So if you are going out, don't forget your umbrella. The rain will stop on Sunday, and it will be warm and sunny again next week.
questions.sentence: What will the weather be like tomorrow afternoon?

questions.explanation:
don't forget your umbrella：記得帶傘。

The rain will stop on Sunday.

I'll be your guide today. 他是導覽員。
逐字稿：Welcome to Greenfield Chocolate Factory. My name is Peter, and I'll be your guide today. First, we will see how our chocolate is made. After that, you can taste five kinds of chocolate in our tasting room. The tour will end at the gift shop, where you can buy chocolate for your friends. Please remember that taking photos is not allowed in the factory.
